title: Promotion receipt — promotion-receipt/1.0
description: plan.md §7.1. specs/_promotions/<cluster>.json (or .yaml). Detached: the receipt is never listed in its own artifact_manifest. States the exact accepted artifact set -- no implicit globs. Any listed file changing invalidates the receipt (acceptance revoked). References are one-way: normative artifacts carry review blocks and never a promotion_id; only generated reports cite promotion_id -- this schema does not require or expect the artifacts it lists to reference it back.

promotion_id.description: Same grammar as the work-package manifest's provenance.promotion_id (docs/work-package-manifest-schema.json) -- one promotion_id format across the pipeline.

cluster.description: Must equal the filename stem -- one promotion receipt per cluster, same discipline as boundary_id==stem for boundary contracts (plan.md §2).

reviewer.description: Top-level, not nested under a review: block -- plan.md §7.1's own worked example shapes it this way, unlike boundary contracts and the project descriptor. Promotion IS the human-sign-off event (§7.2); this field records who performed it.

policy_version.description: e.g. reliance-policy@1.2 -- ties to docs/reliance-policy.md's own change-history version (docs/reliance-policy.template.md).

schema_versions.description: Open -- which schema kinds exist depends on which stages have landed (boundary, work-package-manifest today; interaction, bridge, witness as M3/M4/M6 build them).
